verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows receipt scanning for on-the-go expenses and API endpoints that include receipts. Nothing documents automatic matching of receipts to card transactions, e-receipts pulled from integrations, or nudges sent only when a receipt is genuinely missing. Receipt scanning is a related capture feature, not the matching capability the story asks for, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an employee, receipts match to card transactions automatically — with e-receipts pulled from integrations — and I get nudged only when one is genuinely missing
